reviews.evidence_type: Continuous real wall-clock native semantic-input route using production CharacterController/colliders, E/F pickup, inventory packing, real manual work and natural disaster clocks.
reviews.limits: Semantic API input, not OS keyboard/mouse or human playability/fun acceptance. Menu/selector/start/retry, inventory selection/use and N-equivalent FinishInspection call the exact production action methods. Scripted-input gate suppresses only unscripted input; model, short-flow and cinema clocks stay live. SmokeMove and StepWork use actual frame delta with production safety caps, once per rendered frame; no injected Tick, skip, actor Warp, stock grants, damage edits or developer options. Game-owned start spawns and any game-owned cinematic repositioning are recorded as lifecycle behavior. A completed ordinary simulation loss is recorded as loss, then its production damage-review action opens walkable Inspection while retaining failure/damage and zero reward; it is never reported as survival. Retry reset is checked without repeating every full disaster. Human first-three-minute enjoyment is not measured.
